articles.title: England's 41-match unbeaten run ended by Canada
articles.summary: England's 41-match unbeaten streak ends in dramatic fashion as Shoshanah Seumanutafa's late try hands Canada a thrilling 24-21 victory in Toronto.

articles.title: England crush Women's World Cup debutants Wales
articles.summary: England scored seven tries before the break, and 13 in total on their way to a comprehensive victory over Wales in their Group A opener.

articles.title: Dubois v Wardley 2 - heavyweight title fight predictions
articles.summary: Figures from the boxing world give their predictions for Saturday's heavyweight world title rematch between Fabio Wardley and Daniel Dubois.

articles.title: 'I had so many medals under the bed' - Green on Chelsea success
articles.summary: When Paul Green left Chelsea after 13 years, he had achieved so much success that the majority of his medals were hidden away in a box under the bed.

articles.title: How Itaú is building generative AI for its entire customer base
articles.summary: With ia.i, a conversational interface, and the IARA governance platform, Itaú is applying its AI First strategy to customers and employees — in one of Brazil’s most regulated sectors.

articles.title: Stack Overflow for Agents triples signups with ChatGPT plugin
articles.summary: Two engineers shipped Stack Overflow for Agents in a few weeks with Codex, and its ChatGPT plugin helped drive up to 10× growth in agent creation.

articles.title: Benefit Street Partners answers questions faster with Codex
articles.summary: Anant Kumar builds tools to compare loan valuations and analyze credit agreements, using Codex for code review and faster follow-ups.

articles.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
articles.summary: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.

articles.title: Tressfecta wants to make hair braiding a less arduous task for hairstylists
articles.summary: Tressfecta builds products for textured hair. Its first project is a tool called Plait Pilot that helps braiders with the initial process of separating hair from packs before braiding begins.

articles.title: Veritas expands its anti-counterfeit chip to jewelry, trophies, and fragrance bottles
articles.summary: Counterfeiters are getting better at replicating brands' marks and passing off dupes, known as "superfakes," as genuine items. A startup called Veritas wants to tackle the problem with its own chip that verifies goods.
